name: Blaize & Barrel
address: 12 Marsh St, Mossel Bay, 6005, South Africa
description_short: Family-friendly Mossel Bay eatery serving hearty grills and comfort food in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.
description_long:
Tucked away on Marsh Street in the heart of Mossel Bay, Blaize & Barrel has become a local favourite for families and groups seeking generous portions and honest flavours. The menu leans heavily towards grills and traditional comfort food, with flame-grilled steaks, ribs, and burgers that satisfy without pretence.

The casual, laid-back vibe makes it an easy choice whether you're popping in for a quick bite or settling in for a proper meal with the family. The kitchen delivers consistently good food at prices that won't break the bank, and the friendly service adds to the neighbourhood feel. With its liquor store attached, you can grab a bottle to take home after your meal.

Located just a short walk from the Mossel Bay harbour area, it's a convenient stop after exploring the town's beaches and historic sites. The relaxed atmosphere and child-friendly approach make it a solid option for visitors who want good food without the fuss.
